title: Creeper every minute
description: Have you ever wished creepers didn't exist? Well in this "minecraft but" challenge, i made sure you never say YES!
body:
#                                         **CEM**

Every minute, a very ~~deadly~~ excited creeper will be summoned on your head, please be kind to them, please? This is my first datapack, a simple "minecraft but" challenge, i will make better "minecraft but" challenges in the future.
